description: This file defines a controller class 'Sale' within the Opencart admin module for generating sale reports and listing product sales. It includes methods to initialize sale report tasks, paginate through products, and calculate sales figures.

classes.name: Sale
classes.description: Controller class managing sale report tasks and product sales listing in the OpenCart admin module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates paginated sale report tasks based on product count, preparing task data for each page.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Calculates sales totals for a list of products within specified arguments and returns a success message with range info.
